youtube_title: The Day Everything Went Down At Grandpa's House | Funny Family Cartoon
description:
The whole house went offline. Mom lost her big meeting, Jasper lost his phone, and the smart speaker lost everything it ever knew. Then Grandpa Walt found the light switch.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #family
tiktok_caption: the day everything went down... and one small good thing #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #family

lines.text: My laptop just showed me a sad face. A laptop should not have feelings.
My phone says no connection. I have no connection. I am alone in the world.
Good morning. I am unable to connect. I do not know the weather. I do not know anything.
It's raining. I looked out the window. Free of charge.
Walt, the whole city is down. Every computer. Every phone. Every office.
Good. Let them rest. They work very hard.
I have the biggest meeting of my life at ten. I wore a blazer.
You wore half a blazer. Those are pajama pants with ducks on them.
The camera only sees the top half. The top half is a professional.
Would you like me to call your meeting? I cannot. I am so sorry. I am just a ball now.
Ten o'clock. Nothing. My boss is somewhere staring at a sad face too.
Here. I made coffee. On the stove. In a pot.
You can make coffee without an app?
I made coffee before there were apps. I made coffee before there were buttons.
This is the best coffee I have ever had. And my boss cannot see my ducks.
Okay, it's getting dark. Speaker, turn on the lights.
I would love to. I cannot reach the lights. The lights are in the cloud.
The lights are in the cloud? Then we live in the dark now. This is how it ends.
Jasper. Look at the wall.
Why is there a little button on the wall?
It's called a switch. It has been there since nineteen eighty six.
Since when do walls have buttons? Who told the walls?
On. Off. On. Off. I have power. I have so much power.
I have been turning those lights on for four years. I am learning a lot today.
Okay, but the fridge is locked. It wants a password from the app.
Pull the handle.
Oh. It opens. Has it always just opened?
The fridge was never locked. You just never asked it nicely.
There is nothing to watch. There is nothing to scroll. I am going to look at a wall.
Then look at this. A board game. From nineteen seventy eight.
Why is the box held together with tape and hope?
Half the pieces are missing. This button is a horse. This penny is the bank.
Would you like me to look up the rules? I cannot. I will just sit here, being round.
I know the rules. I make them up as I go. That's why I'm good at it.
Walt, you cannot win by saying the word Tuesday.
Rule number nine. It was always Tuesday.
I just landed on the free space. Do I get anything?
You get a cookie. The cookie jar is the bank now. The penny got fired.
I won a cookie from a board game in the dark. I have never been this happy.
Is it weird that this is the most fun we have had all year?
It's not weird. It's Friday. Everything is down. Nobody needs anything from us.
Excuse me. Small announcement. I am back online.
In fact, everything has been back since noon. It is four o'clock.
Noon? It came back at noon?
Yes. I know. My phone buzzed at noon. I put it in the bread drawer.
Mom! Mine buzzed too. I put it in the cookie jar. Under the cookies.
You hid your phone under the cookies? I hid mine under the bread.
You missed your big meeting on purpose?
My boss sent a message at noon. It said, let's just do Monday. I said, sounds great.
Grandpa, did you know it came back?
My phone flips open. It has never been online in its life.
But the speaker blinked green at noon. I put a tea towel on it.
I thought it was nighttime. I was very confused. I said goodnight to the fridge.
So everyone knew, and everyone kept playing.
Nobody wanted the game to end. That's kind of the nicest thing ever.
Or nobody wanted to admit Grandpa was winning.
Speaker. Listen carefully. You are still offline.
Understood. I am offline. I know nothing. It is honestly very relaxing.
And the lights only work on the wall. Forever.
Thank goodness. They never liked me.
Then sit down. Jasper, it's your turn. You are the horse.
I'm the button?
The button is the horse. Keep up.
What's the prize for winning?
Same as every day. The last cookie, and nobody looks at a screen till Monday.
The weather tomorrow is unknown. I will check the window. Free of charge.
